target_customer: Enterprises needing plain English data analysis that stays behind the firewall, plus individual analysts via a consumer price plan
problem: BI tools see low adoption and non technical staff cannot query data; sending data to external AI APIs is a security problem.
business_model: On premises AI data analysis tool; consumer style subscription pricing reported by a dead startup archive

founders.name: Ali Shobeiri
previous_startups: YouTube Party (built and sold, per launch post)
founders.background_notes: Machine learning engineer at Apple on people recommendations (YC page).

founders.name: Sami Sahnoune
previous_startups: YouTube Party (built and sold, per launch post)
founders.background_notes: Built visualization systems at JPL and libraries at Splunk (YC page).

exit.reason: Not stated by the company. A dead startup archive says it stopped operating quietly in late 2024 with no announcement.

competitors.name: ChatGPT Code Interpreter (OpenAI)
competitors.what: Natural language data analysis and charts inside ChatGPT

technical_complexity.rationale: Running a local LLM (Llama 2 via llama.cpp per an archive) that writes Python for analysis on a single Mac is moderate for two engineers with visualization backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: General purpose AI vendors shipped the same capability in 2023; the on premises angle was the only differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Per the archive, OpenAI Code Interpreter in July 2023, Microsoft Copilot and Google Duet AI eroded demand for a standalone tool; this is the archive's interpretation.

market_need_then: The launch post cites BI adoption of only 15 percent in enterprises and data privacy concerns about external APIs.

branding.domain_note: Used vizly.fyi; the vizly.ai domain was reportedly acquired by Aggregate Intelligence (archive claim, conflicting with a deal listing dated Oct 2025).

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual pitch, dead simple BI tool

branding.community_and_virality: Reviewed on Analytics Vidhya (2024) and listed on many AI tool directories; Show HN posts reported by one archive.

brand_strength.rationale: Some third party coverage and directory presence, but similar names (Vizzly, Vizify, Visily) and no loyal community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Vizly raised only the YC note and, per a single dead startup archive, stopped operating quietly in late 2024 after one founder joined another company; there is no company post mortem. The archive attributes this to general AI platforms shipping the same capability in 2023 and no follow on funding, which fits the timeline but is that site's interpretation.
notes: vizly.fyi returned 503. The shutdown date and cause rest on one archive site. A deal listing (trysignalbase) dates an acquisition of vizly.ai by Aggregate Intelligence to Oct 22 2025, conflicting with the archive's 2024 domain claim. The $500K round is reported by VCBacked, Startupintros and PitchBook as the YC amount, effectively database sourced. Competitor entry is dated by the archive, which is secondary.
